title: Referenzkorpus Frühneuhochdeutsch (ReF; Reference Corpus of Early New High German)
notes: Reference Corpus of Early New High German (1350-1650): diplomatically transcribed texts, annotated at three sites (morphology at Bochum and Halle, syntax at Potsdam). The Zenodo release (version 1.0.2, December 2021; DOI 10.5281/zenodo.5793616) is by Klaus-Peter Wegera, Hans-Joachim Solms, Ulrike Demske and Stefanie Dipper and comprises two archives, the annotated corpus and a reading-text version. No later release was seen. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this edition, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
institution: Ruhr-Universität Bochum; Martin-Luther-Universität Halle-Wittenberg; Universität Potsdam
license_note: The Zenodo record states Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (the catalogue's earlier value, CC-BY-SA-4.0, did not match the record).
